description: This file contains utility functions and description classes for handling F# types within the Orleans code generation framework, including identification of union cases and records, and metadata descriptions for F# union cases and records.

classes.name: FSharpUtilities
classes.description: A static utility class providing methods for recognizing F# union types and records, and containing nested classes that describe union cases and record types for serialization purposes.

classes.name: FSharpUnionCaseTypeDescription
classes.description: Represents a description of an F# union case type, including its data members.

classes.name: FSharpUnionCaseFieldDescription
classes.description: Describes a field within an F# union case, including methods for code generation related to accessors.

classes.name: FSharpRecordTypeDescription
classes.description: Represents a description of an F# record type, including its data members.

classes.name: FSharpRecordPropertyDescription
classes.description: Describes a property within an F# record, including methods for code generation related to accessors.

methods.name: IsUnionCase
methods.description: Determines if a given symbol represents an F# union case and retrieves the associated sum type if true.

methods.name: IsRecord
methods.description: Determines if a given symbol represents an F# record type.

methods.name: GetUnionCaseDataMembers
methods.description: Retrieves the data members (fields) of an F# union case for serialization description.

methods.name: GetRecordDataMembers
methods.description: Retrieves the properties of an F# record to be serialized.
